candidates.description: This vector represents words or word roots beginning with the letters "est" across multiple Romance languages.
This feature vector represents tokens related to variety, difference, and distinction across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents three-digit telephone area codes primarily from North America.
This vector represents Portuguese action verbs and their inflections related to occurrences, changes, and developments.
Portuguese derivational suffixes and related morphological components expressing capability, possibility, and state.
This feature vector represents socio-political, economic, and institutional domains or fields of study.
This feature activates for words and subwords related to administrative systems, political regimes, and structured plans or territories.
This feature vector activates strongly on French and Spanish prepositional or article prefixes starting with the letter 'd'.
This feature represents roots, stems, and prefixes associated with continuity, gradual progression, and completeness across multiple languages.

This feature vector represents large-scale, magnitude-related, or prominent descriptors, frequently manifested through words conveying greatness, intensity, or physical elevation across multiple languages.
